events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Smith Jr. (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bulls.
Caruso (CHI) steps forward into Rozier's (CHA) path and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Richards (CHA) establishes himself in White's (CHI) path and absorbs the incoming contact during the screen.
White (CHI) and Bridges (CHA) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Caruso (CHI) contests Bridges's (CHA) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Vucevic (CHI) briefly grasps Richards' (CHA) left arm and immediately releases him as they pursue the rebound.
Richards (CHA) is moving alongside DeRozan's (CHI) path and DeRozan loses control of the ball on his own.
DeRozan (CHI) steps out of bounds while still in possession of the ball.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hornets.
Bridges (CHA) briefly bobbles the ball during his drive and legally resumes his dribble as he regains control of the ball.
Vucevic (CHI) is already in Miller's (CHA) path and does not deliver contact.
Bridges (CHA) is moving alongside DeRozan's (CHI) path and marginal contact occurs prior to DeRozan's gather.
Bridges (CHA) legally contests DeRozan's (CHI) driving shot attempt.
Bridges (CHA) establishes himself in Caruso's (CHI) path and absorbs the contact during the pick.

From all available angles, it is unclear whether LaVine (CHI) makes contact to the ball or to the lower part of Rozier's (CHA) hand. Taking the angles together, it appears that LaVine makes some contact with the ball. If he did not, a foul would only be warranted if he made contact to the lower part of Rozier's hand while he still had the ball, or to his wrist just after the release of the ball (neither of which can be confirmed).
Smith Jr. (CHA) legally contests DeRozan's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Rozier (CHA) briefly grasps White's (CHI) off-arm as he goes around the pick, and the contact is marginal.
LaVine (CHI) is already in Bridges' (CHA) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Vucevic (CHI) establishes himself in Bridges's (CHA) path and absorbs the incoming contact during the pick.
Richards (CHA) is moving alongside DeRozan's (CHI) path and cleanly blocks the driving shot attempt.
Miller (CHA) attempts to pass the ball to Rozier (CHA) and is the first player to touch the ball after he releases the pass.
Miller (CHA) brings his right arm towards White's (CHI) front and marginal contact occurs as they come together in transition.
Miller (CHA) briefly places his hand on Vucevic's (CHI) shoulder, and marginal contact occurs as he simultaneously deflects the ball away from Vucevic.
Rozier (CHA) is bracing for the contact from Caruso (CHI) and marginal contact occurs as he releases away.
Richards (CHA) moves laterally into White's (CHI) path and initiates body contact that occurs prior to White's gather.
Vucevic (CHI) establishes himself in Bridges's (CHA) path and absorbs the incoming contact during the pick.
Richards (CHA) jumps alongside DeRozan's (CHI) path and legally contests the driving shot attempt.
Smith Jr. (CHA) does not establish himself in Caruso's (CHI) path, and he initiates contact with Caruso.
Smith Jr. (CHA) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
